description: This file provides legacy helper functions for tenant selection management in a frontend application, including getting and setting the active tenant ID in local storage, and determining if tenant selection UI should be displayed. It is intended for backward compatibility, with a note to prefer newer modules.

methods.name: getActiveTenantId()
methods.description: Reads the active tenant ID from local storage, prioritizing the new key 'activeTenant' and falling back to the legacy 'activeTenantId'.

methods.name: setActiveTenantId(tenantId)
methods.description: Stores the active tenant ID in local storage using the new key 'activeTenant', removing the legacy key if provided, and cleans up legacy data.

methods.name: needsTenantSelection(tenants)
methods.description: Determines whether the tenant selection UI should be shown based on current active tenant and tenants list.
